name: CapitaLand Malaysia Trust
overview: 2026年公告主要为证券发行、股息分派及季度业绩，未披露零售、物流或工业物业板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约事项。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长9.3%，净利润同比增长34.1%。
overview_en: The 2026 announcements mainly cover securities issuance, income distributions and quarterly results, with no disclosed expansion, reduction, disposal or new contracts for the retail, logistics or industrial property segments. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue rose 9.3% year-on-year and net profit rose 34.1% year-on-year.
